en.L: He opened a rock, and waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.
en.B: He opened up a rock and water streamed out, running like a river through the parched land.
en.R: He split a rock open, and water came pouring out. It flowed through the desert like a river.

fr.L: Il a ouvert un rocher, et les eaux ont jailli ; elles ont coulé dans les lieux arides [comme] un fleuve.
fr.B: Il a ouvert un rocher et l’eau en est sortie à flots, coulant comme un fleuve à travers la terre desséchée.
fr.R: Il a fendu un rocher, et l’eau en est sortie à grands flots. Elle a coulé dans le désert comme une rivière.

sw.L: Aliufungua mwamba, maji yakabubujika; yalipita mahali pakavu [kama] mto.
sw.B: Aliupasua mwamba, maji yakatiririka, yakipita katika nchi kavu kama mto.
sw.R: Aliupasua mwamba, na maji yakatoka kwa nguvu. Yalitiririka jangwani kama mto.

es.L: Abrió una roca, y brotaron aguas; corrieron por los lugares secos [como] un río.
es.B: Abrió una roca y salió agua a chorros, que corría como un río por la tierra reseca.
es.R: Partió una roca, y el agua salió a borbotones. Corría por el desierto como un río.

vi.L: Ngài mở tảng đá, và nước tuôn ra; chảy trong những nơi khô hạn [như] một dòng sông.
vi.B: Ngài chẻ tảng đá ra và nước tuôn trào, chảy như dòng sông qua vùng đất khô cằn.
vi.R: Ngài chẻ một tảng đá ra, và nước tuôn chảy. Nước chảy qua sa mạc như một dòng sông.

ko.L: 그분께서 바위를 여시니 물이 솟아 나왔고, 마른 땅에 강[처럼] 흘렀다.
ko.B: 그분께서 바위를 여시자 물이 쏟아져 나와 메마른 땅에 강처럼 흘렀다.
ko.R: 그분께서 바위를 쪼개시자 물이 콸콸 쏟아져 나왔다. 그 물은 사막에서 강처럼 흘렀다.

pt.L: Ele abriu uma rocha, e jorraram águas; correram pelos lugares secos [como] um rio.
pt.B: Ele abriu uma rocha, e a água saiu em torrentes, correndo como um rio pela terra seca.
pt.R: Ele rachou uma rocha, e a água saiu jorrando. Ela correu pelo deserto como um rio.

am.L: ዓለትን ከፈተ፤ ውኆችም ፈለቁ፤ በደረቅ ስፍራዎች እንደ ወንዝ ፈሰሱ።
am.B: ዓለትን ከፈተ፤ ውኃም ጎረፈ፤ በደረቁ ምድር ውስጥ እንደ ወንዝ ፈሰሰ።
am.R: ዓለትን ሰንጥቆ ከፈተ፤ ውኃም ተንዶለዶለ። በምድረ በዳው ውስጥ እንደ ወንዝ ፈሰሰ።

hi.L: उन्होंने चट्टान को खोला, और जल फूट निकला; वह सूखे स्थानों में नदी [के समान] बहा।
hi.B: उन्होंने एक चट्टान को खोल दिया और पानी बह निकला, जो सूखी भूमि में नदी के समान बहने लगा।
hi.R: उन्होंने एक चट्टान को चीर दिया, और पानी फूट निकला। वह रेगिस्तान में नदी की तरह बहने लगा।

ru.L: Он раскрыл скалу, и хлынули воды; они потекли по сухим местам, [как] река.
ru.B: Он рассёк скалу, и вода заструилась, побежав, как река, по иссохшей земле.
ru.R: Он расколол скалу, и оттуда хлынула вода. Она текла по пустыне, как река.

ja.L: その方が岩を開かれると、水がほとばしり出て、乾いた所を川となって流れた。
ja.B: その方が岩を開かれると、水が流れ出し、乾ききった地を川のように流れた。
ja.R: その方が岩を割って開かれると、水があふれ出た。水は川のように、砂漠を流れた。

uk.L: Він відкрив скелю, і полилися води; вони потекли в сухих місцях [як] ріка.
uk.B: Він розкрив скелю, і ринула вода, потекла, як ріка, спраглою землею.
uk.R: Він розколов скелю, і полилася вода. Вона текла пустелею, як ріка.

decisions.reason: Water came from the rock at Horeb (Exodus 17:6) and at Kadesh (Numbers 20:11; Psalm 78:15-16).
The word (tsiyyah) is dry, waterless country (63:2).

source.text: כִּֽי־זָ֭כַר אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת־אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For he remembered his holy word, with Abraham his servant.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remembered {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy word with Abraham {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remembered the holy word {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken to Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant.
en.R: He did all this because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remembered the holy promise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Abraham.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est souvenu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte parole, avec Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est souvenu de la sainte parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite à Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur.
fr.R: Il a fait tout cela parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est souvenu de la sainte promesse qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait faite à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Abraham.

sw.L: Kwa maana alilikumbuka neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu, pamoja na Abrahamu mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana alilikumbuka neno takatifu alilomwambia Abrahamu, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Alifanya hayo yote kwa sababu aliikumbuka ahadi takatifu aliyomwahidi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Abrahamu.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acordó de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santa palabra con Abraham {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acordó de la santa palabra que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había dado a Abraham, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo.
es.R: Hizo todo esto porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acordó de la santa promesa que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Abraham.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhớ lời thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với Áp-ra-ham, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhớ lời thánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với Áp-ra-ham, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài làm tất cả những điều ấy vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ lời hứa thánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với Áp-ra-ham, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 그분께서는 그분의 거룩한 말씀을, 그분의 종 아브라함과 [맺으신 것을] 기억하셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그분의 종 아브라함에게 하신 거룩한 말씀을 기억하셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 이 모든 일을 하신 것은 그분의 종 아브라함에게 하신 거룩한 약속을 기억하셨기 때문이다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lembrou da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santa palavra [dada] a Abraão, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo.
pt.B: Pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lembrou da santa palavra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha dito a Abraão, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo.
pt.R: Ele fez tudo isso porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lembrou da santa promessa que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo Abraão.

am.L: ቅዱስ ቃሉን ከባሪያው ከአብርሃም ጋር አስቧልና።
am.B: ለአገልጋዩ ለአብርሃም የተናገረውን ቅዱስ ቃል አስቧልና።
am.R: ይህን ሁሉ ያደረገው ለአገልጋዩ ለአብርሃም የሰጠውን ቅዱስ ተስፋ ስላሰበ ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्होंने अपने पवित्र वचन को स्मरण किया, [जो] अपने दास अब्राहम के साथ [था]।
hi.B: क्योंकि उन्होंने वह पवित्र वचन याद रखा जो उन्होंने अपने दास अब्राहम से कहा था।
hi.R: उन्होंने यह सब इसलिए किया क्योंकि उन्हें वह पवित्र प्रतिज्ञा याद थी जो उन्होंने अपने दास अब्राहम से की थी।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вспомнил своё святое слово с Авраамом, своим рабом.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вспомнил святое слово, которое сказал Аврааму, своему рабу.
ru.R: Он сделал всё это, потому что помнил святое обещание, которое дал своему рабу Аврааму.

ja.L: まことに、その方はご自分の聖なる言葉を、ご自分のしもべアブラハムと共に覚えておられた。
ja.B: その方が、ご自分のしもべアブラハムに語られた聖なる言葉を、覚えておられたからである。
ja.R: その方がこうしてくださったのは、ご自分のしもべアブラハムにしてくださった聖なる約束を、覚えておられたからだ。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} згадав своє святе слово до Авраама, свого раба.
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} памʼятав святе слово, яке сказав Авраамові, своєму рабові.
uk.R: Він зробив усе це, бо памʼятав святу обіцянку, яку дав своєму рабові Авраамові.

decisions.choice: he remembered: the frame of the psalm
decisions.reason: The verb takes up verse 8, "he remembers his covenant": everything from Joseph to the wilderness happened because God kept his word.
God told Abraham that his offspring would be slaves in a foreign land and would come out with great possessions, and return to Canaan (Genesis 15:13-16).

decisions.choice: his holy word ... with Abraham: the promise made with him
decisions.reason: "With" ('et) links the word to Abraham as the covenant partner: the promise God made with him.
Readable makes the link to the story before it plain.

decisions.choice: zakhar "覚えておられた", as 105:8 "覚えておられる"
decisions.reason: He remembered is the frame of the psalm (m1); the same verb is kept as in 105:8. The holy word with Abraham is the promise made with him (m3).

source.text: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־בְּחִירָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought out his people with joy, with a shout of joy his chosen ones.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people with joy, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chosen ones with shouts of joy.
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people out rejoicing, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chosen ones singing aloud for joy.
en.R: He led {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chosen people out, and they were happy and shouting for joy.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple dans la joie, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} élus avec des cris de joie.
fr.B: Ainsi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple dans l’allégresse, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} élus chantant à pleine voix leur joie.
fr.R: Il a fait sortir le peuple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait choisi, et ils étaient heureux et criaient de joie.

sw.L: Naye akawatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa furaha, wateule {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa kelele za shangwe.
sw.B: Hivyo akawaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watoke wakishangilia, wateule {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakiimba kwa sauti kuu kwa furaha.
sw.R: Aliwaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliowachagua watoke, nao walifurahi na kupiga kelele za shangwe.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sacó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo con gozo, con gritos de júbilo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} escogidos.
es.B: Así {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sacó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo lleno de alegría, a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} escogidos cantando de júbilo.
es.R: Sacó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo escogido, y ellos estaban felices y gritaban de alegría.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trong vui mừng, những người được chọn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong tiếng reo hò.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trong niềm hân hoan, những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn cất tiếng hát vang mừng rỡ.
vi.R: Ngài dẫn dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn ra đi, và họ vui mừng reo hò.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 그분의 백성을 기쁨으로, 그분의 택하신 이들을 기쁨의 외침으로 이끌어 내셨다.
ko.B: 그리하여 그분께서는 그분의 백성을 기뻐하며 나오게 하시고, 그분께서 택하신 이들을 기쁨의 노래를 부르며 나오게 하셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 택하신 백성을 이끌어 내시니, 그들이 기뻐하며 환호했다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez sair o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo com alegria, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} escolhidos com gritos de júbilo.
pt.B: Assim {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} conduziu o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo para fora em festa, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} escolhidos cantando alto de alegria.
pt.R: Ele levou para fora o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo escolhido, e eles estavam felizes e gritando de alegria.

am.L: ሕዝቡን በደስታ፣ የመረጣቸውንም በእልልታ አወጣ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ሕዝቡን በደስታ፣ የመረጣቸውንም በታላቅ የደስታ ዝማሬ መራ።
am.R: የመረጠውን ሕዝቡን መራ፤ እነርሱም ደስ ብሏቸው እልል ይሉ ነበር።

hi.L: और वे अपनी प्रजा को आनंद के साथ, अपने चुने हुओं को जयजयकार के साथ निकाल लाए।
hi.B: इस प्रकार वे अपनी प्रजा को आनंद मनाते हुए बाहर ले आए, अपने चुने हुए लोगों को ऊँचे स्वर से गाते हुए।
hi.R: वे अपनी चुनी हुई प्रजा को बाहर ले आए, और लोग आनंदित होकर जयजयकार कर रहे थे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вывел свой народ с радостью, своих избранных — с ликованием.
ru.B: Так {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вывел свой народ ликующим, своих избранных — громко поющими от радости.
ru.R: Он вывел свой избранный народ, и люди радовались и кричали от радости.

ja.L: その方はご自分の民を喜びのうちに、ご自分の選ばれた者たちを喜びの叫びのうちに連れ出された。
ja.B: こうして、その方はご自分の民を、喜びのうちに導き出された。ご自分の選ばれた者たちは、喜びの声を上げて歌った。
ja.R: その方は、ご自分が選ばれた民を導き出された。彼らは喜んで、喜びの声を上げた。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вивів свій народ із радістю, своїх вибраних — із радісним співом.
uk.B: Тож {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вивів свій народ, що радів, своїх вибраних, що голосно співали з радості.
uk.R: Він вивів свій вибраний народ, і вони були щасливі й радісно вигукували.

decisions.reason: After the crossing Moses and the people sang, and Miriam and the women danced (Exodus 15:1-21).

decisions.choice: shout of joy: a ringing cry
decisions.reason: The word (rinnah) is a loud, glad cry or song.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he gave to them [the] lands of nations, and [the] toil of peoples they possessed,

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them the lands of nations, and they took possession of the toil of peoples,
en.B: He gave them the lands of other nations, and they took over what those peoples had worked for,
en.R: He gave them the land where other nations lived. They took over fields and homes that others had worked hard to build.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a donné les terres des nations, et ils ont pris possession du labeur des peuples,
fr.B: Il leur a donné les terres d’autres nations, et ils ont pris ce que ces peuples avaient acquis par leur travail,
fr.R: Il leur a donné le pays où vivaient d’autres nations. Ils ont pris des champs et des maisons pour lesquels d’autres avaient travaillé dur.

sw.L: Naye akawapa nchi za mataifa, nao wakamiliki taabu ya mataifa,
sw.B: Aliwapa nchi za mataifa mengine, nao wakachukua kile ambacho watu hao walikuwa wamekifanyia kazi,
sw.R: Aliwapa nchi walimoishi mataifa mengine. Walichukua mashamba na nyumba ambazo wengine walikuwa wamejitahidi sana kuzijenga.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dio las tierras de las naciones, y se adueñaron del trabajo de los pueblos,
es.B: Les dio las tierras de otras naciones, y se quedaron con lo que esos pueblos habían trabajado,
es.R: Les dio la tierra donde vivían otras naciones. Se quedaron con campos y casas que otros habían trabajado mucho para construir.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ những đất của các dân tộc, và họ chiếm hữu công lao của các dân,
vi.B: Ngài ban cho họ đất đai của các dân tộc khác, và họ tiếp nhận thành quả lao nhọc của các dân ấy,
vi.R: Ngài ban cho họ đất nơi các dân tộc khác từng sống. Họ nhận lấy ruộng đồng và nhà cửa mà người khác đã vất vả gây dựng.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 그들에게 민족들의 땅을 주셨고, 그들은 백성들의 수고를 차지하였다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그들에게 다른 민족들의 땅을 주셨고, 그들은 그 백성들이 힘들여 일군 것을 차지했다.
ko.R: 그분께서 다른 민족들이 살던 땅을 그들에게 주셨다. 그들은 다른 사람들이 애써 일군 밭과 집을 차지했다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes deu as terras das nações, e eles tomaram posse do fruto do trabalho dos povos,
pt.B: Ele lhes deu as terras de outras nações, e eles ficaram com aquilo pelo que esses povos tinham trabalhado,
pt.R: Ele deu a eles a terra onde outras nações moravam. Eles ficaram com campos e casas que outros tinham trabalhado muito para construir.

am.L: የሕዝቦችንም ምድር ሰጣቸው፤ የወገኖችንም ድካም ወረሱ፣
am.B: የሌሎችን ሕዝቦች ምድር ሰጣቸው፤ እነዚያ ወገኖች የደከሙበትንም ወረሱ፣
am.R: ሌሎች ሕዝቦች ይኖሩበት የነበረውን ምድር ሰጣቸው። ሌሎች ደክመው የሠሯቸውን እርሻዎችና ቤቶች ወረሱ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उन्हें जातियों के देश दिए, और उन्होंने लोगों के परिश्रम [के फल] पर अधिकार कर लिया,
hi.B: उन्होंने उन्हें दूसरे राष्ट्रों के देश दे दिए, और जो कुछ उन लोगों ने मेहनत से कमाया था, वह उनके अधिकार में आ गया,
hi.R: उन्होंने उन्हें वह देश दिया जहाँ दूसरे लोग रहते थे। जो खेत और घर दूसरों ने बड़ी मेहनत से बनाए थे, वे उनके हो गए।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал им земли народов, и они завладели трудом племён,
ru.B: Он дал им земли других народов, и они овладели тем, ради чего трудились те племена,
ru.R: Он дал им землю, где жили другие народы. Они получили поля и дома, над которыми трудились другие.

decisions.choice: the purpose of the whole story
decisions.reason: God's gifts, from the promise to the land, were given so that his people would live by his ways. The gift comes first; obedience is the answer to it (Deuteronomy 4:40).
The word (torah, here plural) is instruction or teaching, as in 1:2.

The cry "Hallelu-yah" is a command to a group, "praise", with Yah, the short form of the divine name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2). It is rendered "Praise the LORD", with Yah as the alternative for the name.
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "teaching" for torah.

decisions.choice: God's torah (here the plural torot): "la loi" (Literal), "l'instruction" (Balanced), "l'enseignement" (Readable), for Psalms 105–118
decisions.reason: Torah is God's teaching, of which the Law of Moses is the written heart. Literal keeps the traditional word; Balanced and Readable say what it is, teaching that guides, as the English "instructions" and "teaching" do.

decisions.choice: Hallelu Yah is "Louez le SEIGNEUR", with "Yah", the short form of the name, as the reader's alternative, for Psalms 105–118
decisions.reason: The words are a command to praise and are translated as such, with the name in the same form as everywhere else; "Alléluia" would keep the Hebrew sound but not its sense.

decisions.choice: *Hallelu Yah* as "Msifuni BWANA" with "Yah" as the divine_name alternative
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is a plural command, "praise Yah"; "Msifuni" says it to the whole people, and the setting shows the short name Yah. "Haleluya" is the familiar church word but gives a Swahili reader no meaning.

Hallelu Yah is a plural command, "praise Yah", Yah being the short form of God's name. Spanish translates it, as the English does, with the plural you setting on the verb and "al SEÑOR" by default, "a Yah" with the name setting. "Aleluya" is the familiar borrowed word, but it hides that the line is a call to the hearers.

The Hebrew torot are God's teachings for life. As in Psalm 1, Literal and Balanced say "instrucciones", Readable "enseñanza"; the statutes (ḥuqqim) are "estatutos" or "decretos", and "leyes" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Hãy ca ngợi CHÚA" for Hallelu-Yah, with "Gia" as the divine_name alternative for the short name Yah
decisions.reason: The terms note translates the call to praise, as the English does; the short name Yah takes the setting, so a reader who chooses the name sees "Gia". |

decisions.choice: "những lời chỉ dạy" (L, B), "lời dạy" (R) for torot
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads torot as God's instructions; Vietnamese follows the English levels' "instructions" and "teaching" rather than the narrower "luật pháp" (law). |

decisions.choice: "Hallelu-yah" is "{{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라", a plain-style command to the people, with 야 (Yah) as the alternative
decisions.reason: The cry is a command to a group to praise Yah, the short form of the divine name (meaning decision). Korean gives its sense rather than the borrowed "할렐루야", as the English does, and keeps the plain command of the psalm's calls to praise; the particle stands outside the span and fits both 주 and 야.

decisions.choice: "가르침" for God's torot (instructions) at every level
decisions.reason: The word (torah) is instruction or teaching (meaning decision); "율법" sounds like a legal code. "가르침" is also the Korean word for a parent's torah in Proverbs.
As in 104:35: "Aleluia" holds the short name inside one word, so Literal and Balanced have no span here; Readable says "Louvem o SENHOR", with "Iá" under the setting.
The English translates hallelu-yah, so the Amharic uses the terms list's translated form.

God's torot take the poetry note's words, "व्यवस्था" at Literal and Balanced and "शिक्षा" at Readable (meaning m2). Hallelu-yah, "Praise Yah" (meaning m3), is in the note's form, with "याह" as the divine_name alternative.
The poetry note's form for Hallelu-yah (m3), with the short name Yah as the alternative.
The poetry note has "Закон" (L, B) and "наставление" (R) for God's torah; here the word is plural, God's instructions, so it is written with a small letter.

decisions.choice: chuqqaw "定め" (L, B), "きまり" (R); torotaw "教え"; hallelu-yah "{{divine_name:主|ヤハ}}を賛美せよ" (L, B), "…しよう" (R)
decisions.reason: The purpose of the whole story (m1); torah is 教え in the Psalter, never 律法 (m2); Hallelu-yah (m3) as Psalm 104:35.
